definitions.gloss: prolonged rain; long spell of rain
definitions.explanation: Rain that continues for many days without stopping. Often associated with the rainy season (梅雨) in Japan.

examples.japanese: {長雨|ながあめ}が{続|つづ}いている。
{長雨|ながあめ}のせいで{洗濯物|せんたくもの}が{乾|かわ}かない。
examples.english: Because of the long rain, the laundry won't dry.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{梅雨|つゆ}は{長雨|ながあめ}で、{農作物|のうさくもつ}に{大|おお}きな{被害|ひがい}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: This year's rainy season brought prolonged rain, causing significant damage to crops.

notes:
Compound of {長|なが} (long) + {雨|あめ} (rain). Refers to continuous rainfall lasting several days or more, not just a single long rainstorm.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長雨|ながあめ}が{続|つづ}く (the long rain continues)
- {長雨|ながあめ}の{影響|えいきょう} (the effects of prolonged rain)
- {長雨|ながあめ}による{被害|ひがい} (damage from prolonged rain)

USAGE NOTE:
Often used in weather reports and news about the {梅雨|つゆ} (rainy season, June–July). Can also describe any extended period of rain outside the rainy season, such as {秋|あき}の{長雨|ながあめ} (autumn long rains).
